name.ja: BB戦士317 周倉ドーベンウルフ

ja: ●三国伝に新たな武将“周倉ドーベンウルフ”が出陣 ●武器は専用の大斧、背中に装備した刀×2が付属 ●大斧と2本刀は大型武器「三爪戟」に合体可能 ●鎧は着脱可能
en: -A new military commander in the Sangokuden, "Shukura Dobenwolf " has entered the battle. -Weapons include a special large ax and 2 swords equipped on the back. -The large ax and two swords can be combined into a large weapon, the " three-clawed sword." -The armor is removable.
